name: Nakahara Kirito
source:
Kirito is a famous model and a laboratory assistant of Aizawa. The only reason Kirito works for himis to get closer to his son, Kai Nagase, whom he is in love with. Like Aizawa and Nagase, Kirito also disdains Ren Shiina.

He is well known for his frequent mental freak outs and love for sharp objects.

[From [url=https://sukisho.fandom.com/wiki/Kirito_Nakahara]Sukisho Wiki[/url]]
